description:
A reviewer-authorized clean-room workflow rehearses only authenticated immutable escrow bytes while every final v1 channel remains absent.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Dispatch accepts the exact candidate release/root identity, downloads assets by numeric ID, verifies checksums, attestations, and provenance, and runs native, extracted-source, MCP, OCI, server/API/web/SSE, profile quickstart, schema, persistence, and frozen-doc procedures.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preflight proves final npm 1.0.0, v1.0.0 tag/release, and GHCR :1.0.0 are absent; rehearsal rejects Actions ZIPs as byte authority, source refs, repacks, rebuilt inputs, or altered frozen instructions.
- [hard] REQ-03: The workflow emits one attested rehearsal envelope tied to exact escrow assets and covers failure, substitution, and public-channel-conflict fixtures without publishing anything.

## Notes

Blast radius: clean-room rehearsal workflow YAML and hosted rehearsal fixtures only.
title: Implement clean-room rehearsal workflows
